output_list.reason: The 'buy' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'amount' is calculated as msg.value * buyRate, if buyRate is set to a very large value, the calculation will overflow, causing the 'amount' to be zero, and the buy function to become inactive.

The 'withdrawToOwner' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'amountWei' is transferred to the owner, if this value is very large, the transfer will cause an overflow, allowing the owner to steal funds from the contract.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is added to 'balanceOf[_to]', if '_to' is set to a very large address, the addition will overflow and cause 'balanceOf[_to]' to be set to zero, preventing transfers.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is added to 'balanceOf[_to]', if '_to' is set to a very large address, the addition will overflow and cause 'balanceOf[_to]' to be set to zero, preventing transfers.

The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is added to 'totalSupply' and 'balanceOf[target]', if 'target' is set to a very large address, the additions will overflow and increase the 'totalSupply' and 'balanceOf[target]' by a predictable amount, allowing the owner to steal the tokens.
